contradictions.a: Prosa: 'subject to customary closing conditions, including applicable regulatory approvals' (10-K filed 2025-11-06) and 'expected to close during the second half of 2024' (Visa release 2023-12-15)
contradictions.b: Mexico's CNA rejected the acquisition (EPI, 2026-02-23) — status change after the filing; the deal did not close

contradictions.a: Visa Direct endpoints: '11B+ endpoints' and '~10B Visa Direct transactions' for FY24 (Investor Day)
contradictions.b: 'approximately 12 billion endpoints' and 'more than 12.5 billion transactions' for FY25 (10-K) — growth between dates

contradictions.a: Visa Rules (18 April 2026 edition) still name 'Discover Financial Services' as a competitive entity whose marks may not appear on Plus cards
contradictions.b: Capital One completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services on May 18, 2025 (context supplied by the study brief; not restated in the Rules)
